title: Student Life
subtitle: Explore the vibrant campus life at Al-Noor Academy
intro: At Al-Noor Academy, we believe education extends beyond the classroom. Our diverse range of extracurricular activities helps students discover their passions, develop leadership skills, and build lasting friendships.

clubs.title: Clubs & Societies
clubs.subtitle: Join a community of like-minded students

debate.name: Debate Club
debate.description: Develop critical thinking and public speaking skills through competitive debates and discussions.

science.name: Science Club
science.description: Explore the wonders of science through experiments, projects, and science fairs.

art.name: Art & Craft Club
art.description: Express your creativity through various art forms including painting, calligraphy, and crafts.

quran.name: Quran Study Circle
quran.description: Deepen your understanding of the Holy Quran through recitation, tajweed, and tafseer.

robotics.name: Robotics Club
robotics.description: Build and program robots while learning about engineering and technology.

drama.name: Drama Club
drama.description: Develop acting skills and participate in theatrical productions and skits.

sports.title: Sports & Athletics
sports.subtitle: Building champions on and off the field

cricket.name: Cricket
cricket.description: Our cricket team competes at district and provincial levels with excellent coaching facilities.

football.name: Football
football.description: Train with professional coaches and compete in inter-school tournaments.

basketball.name: Basketball
basketball.description: Indoor basketball courts with regular training sessions and competitions.

badminton.name: Badminton
badminton.description: State-of-the-art indoor courts for both recreational and competitive play.

tabletennis.name: Table Tennis
tabletennis.description: Multiple tables available for practice and inter-house competitions.

athletics.name: Athletics
athletics.description: Track and field events including running, long jump, and shot put.

council.title: Student Council
council.subtitle: Student leadership and governance
council.description: Our Student Council provides students with the opportunity to develop leadership skills, represent their peers, and contribute to school improvement initiatives.

library.name: Library
library.description: Well-stocked library with over 10,000 books, journals, and digital resources.

labs.name: Science Labs
labs.description: Fully equipped physics, chemistry, biology, and computer laboratories.

playground.name: Playground
playground.description: Large outdoor playground with cricket pitch, football field, and athletics track.

cafeteria.name: Cafeteria
cafeteria.description: Hygienic cafeteria serving nutritious meals and snacks.

auditorium.name: Auditorium
auditorium.description: 500-seat auditorium for assemblies, performances, and events.

mosque.name: Masjid
mosque.description: On-campus mosque for daily prayers and Friday congregation.
